title: Escudero calls out fire effect in Sara Duterte trial livestream
summary: The transition effect briefly appears during the opening prayer led by Senator-judge Alan Peter Cayetano

blocks.text: A fire transition briefly appeared in the livestream of the impeachment trial
The transition effect briefly appears during the opening prayer led by Senator-judge Alan Peter Cayetano

MANILA, Philippines – Senate impeachment court presiding officer Francis “Chiz” Escudero flagged a brief fire transition effect that appeared during the livestream of Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial on Thursday, November 19, and reminded Senate staff to be more mindful of broadcast effects.
The effect appeared during the opening prayer led by Senator-judge Alan Peter Cayetano.

Escudero subsequently directed the Senate clerk of court to instruct the Senate Public Relations and Information Bureau (PRIB) to be more mindful of using such effects. He also ordered the bureau to remove the fire transition effect from the recording.

blocks.caption: Escudero calls out fire effect in Sara Duterte trial livestream

blocks.text: “The flames were not well-taken and inappropriate to these proceedings. Kindly be mindful,” Escudero said.

The Senate PRIB serves as the information and communications arm of the upper chamber. It manages the Senate’s print and broadcast media services, including the live-streaming of the widely publicized impeachment trial.
In a press statement, the bureau apologized over the incident, explaining it was due to an “unexpected technical issue.”

“We sincerely apologize for the accidental transition effect that appeared during the livestream of the Senate Impeachment Court proceedings today. The incident was due to an unexpected technical issue during the broadcast, which we deeply regret,” the Senate PRIB said.

“The PRIB is currently upgrading its equipment and undergoing retraining and upskilling of its technical staff in a bid to strengthen the quality of broadcast media coverage for the Filipino people,” it added. – Rappler.com
